description: Full body chibi anime pixel art game sprite, 6-year-old little girl facing the viewer, standing straight, arms relaxed at sides, empty hands. Chestnut-brown hair in a high ponytail with side bangs, big warm amber eyes, cheerful face. Simple village kid clothes: off-white linen blouse, small laced brown vest, dark green scarf, belt, short dark brown skirt over black leggings, brown leather boots.

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the drawing style and the small-child chibi body proportions (very big head, short body), black pixel outline, shading and detail level. Do NOT copy the colors, hair or clothing.
